value.rationale: The asymmetric family is the natural two-spoke-length extension of triangular-book Lipschitz metrics, with all edges metrically essential. An exact John ellipsoid, whole-orbit contact screening twice, a strictly expanding ambient polytope with fixed inscribed ellipsoid, precise curvature jumps, and \(1/m\)-width phase collapse are substantial natural geometric information. These are not cheap tautological deductions of a known unit-edge calculation, nor arbitrary unmotivated finite slices.
